nodes.label: OpenCode Brand design system
nodes.rationale: Terminal-native design system documented in the Google Stitch DESIGN.md 9-section format, extended with iconography and document policies. Ships Button, Input, Table, Card, Badge, Tabs, Dialog.

nodes.label: Berkeley Mono single-typeface system
nodes.rationale: One monospace family for headings, body, buttons and navigation expresses an 'everything is code' identity; hierarchy comes from size and three weights (700/500/400) alone. Introducing a sans or serif voice would break the terminal-native identity.

nodes.label: Warm near-black palette (#171717 / #fdfcfc)
nodes.rationale: Pure #000000 and #ffffff read as a generic cold dark theme. A reddish-warm near-black rgb(32,29,29) with warm off-white text, plus warm transparent borders rgba(15,0,0,0.12), gives the lived-in terminal warmth that distinguishes the brand.

nodes.label: Apple HIG semantic color set
nodes.rationale: Blue #007aff, red #ff3b30, green #30d158, orange #ff9f0a are borrowed rather than invented because they are the signal colors developers already trust, adding status semantics without brand complexity. Each has a three-stage default -> hover -> active darkening.

nodes.label: Flat, shadowless depth system
nodes.rationale: Zero box-shadow tokens were detected in extraction; depth is expressed only through three border levels and background shifts between #171717 and #302c2c. Terminals do not cast shadows, so neither does the system. Radius is 4px everywhere (6px for inputs) to stay utilitarian.

nodes.label: Dark mode token overrides
nodes.rationale: Dark tokens are scoped under .dark OR a prefers-color-scheme media query — never both, to keep one source of truth. Primary stays #171717 because the brand anchor must be theme-stable; shadows must be lightened and images given dark variants.

nodes.label: Iconography and SVG guidelines
nodes.rationale: One icon library only (Lucide / Radix / Heroicons), inline SVG components rather than img tags so color and size are controllable, and currentColor fills so icons inherit theme color instead of hard-coding hex.

nodes.label: No-emoji document policy
nodes.rationale: Emojis render inconsistently across platforms and break visual coherence, so status indicators use colored dots or icon components and section markers use text prefixes instead.

nodes.label: Terminal hero / CLI-install-as-marketing
nodes.rationale: The hero is a full-width dark terminal window showing the real install command, which reinforces the CLI-first product identity better than a generic marketing headline.

nodes.label: OpenCode brand narrative (SST, Dax Raad)
nodes.rationale: Open-source AI coding agent from the SST team; server-client architecture from day one so any frontend (terminal, desktop, web, mobile) can attach. Positioned as a serious developer tool respecting CLI heritage, never framed via generic Cursor comparisons.
